name: decaframe
stderr:
decaframe — an agent-first visual document product

  deca open [file]   open a document in the editor, in a browser window. Runs until Ctrl-C
  deca mcp           run the MCP server on stdio (a CLIENT spawns this; it is not typed by hand)
  deca login         sign in with Google, in Chrome; the token lives in your config folder
  deca logout        forget that token here and revoke it on the site
  deca help          this message

A document is a .json file and that is the master copy; an exported .html is an artifact, and a
document may have as many as it likes. Both commands take the same paths and refuse the same ones.

Environment:
  DECAFRAME_DOC            the document file; unset, deca mcp names a new one from its title
  DECAFRAME_APP            the editor's origin, default https://app.decaframe.com
  DECAFRAME_CHANNEL_PORT   dev only: a fixed port for the change channel (default: a free one)
  DECAFRAME_CHANNEL_TOKEN  dev only: a fixed token (default: minted per process)
  DECAFRAME_NO_BROWSER     deca open: print the link and open no window
  DECAFRAME_CONFIG_DIR     where auth.json lives (default: ~/.config/decaframe, or XDG_CONFIG_HOME)

Every diagnostic this command writes goes to stderr: stdout is the JSON-RPC stream.
